correctness.rationale: Both the original table and the repaired rational-node profiles are correct. For odd-characteristic genus two the even-subset/two-torsion model is Galois-equivariant, and trope incidence selects exactly affine maximal isotropic planes. Directions correspond to perfect matchings. In an origin-containing tetrad, count 0 and each individually stable edge; in another coset mark the third matching edge and count fixed crossing pairs of the two remaining edges. If the two blocks are preserved separately, only pointwise fixation of their union contributes; if exchanged, the two potential crossing pairs are fixed exactly when Frobenius squared is trivial on them. I independently enumerated the no-three-on-a-trope supports, the powers of each of the eleven class representatives, and the fixed marked-matchings calculation; all rows agree, including the original full orbit table (python3 /workspace/branches/independent_arithmetic.py). The repaired table works over extensions by taking powers, requires no genericity, and does not claim rationality of a Cremona map or realization of every type over each fixed field. The uploaded checker was inspected, not executed.

value.rationale: The repaired classification measures rational nodes available in a descended Göpel structure, not merely which structures descend. For instance a transposition gives six stable structures with no rational node as well as six wholly rational ones, and two three-cycles give exactly one rational node in each stable structure. Those are useful differences for working with arithmetic marked two-torsion configurations; this is a complete incidence distribution across the prescribed Frobenius types, not a recomputation of the already covered zeta table.
